services.desc: Summer is the time for fun and connecting with family and friends. Over the Toon’s boats are clean, modern, and come loaded with accessories to ensure your boating experience is memorable and safe. From stand-up paddle boards, a floating lily pad, towable tubes, or floating lounge chairs, you choose how to spend the perfect day on one of North Carolina’s beautiful lakes! services.name: Jordan Lake Boat Rental
services.desc: Over The Toon, LLC is a rental company providing pontoon boat rental services to Harris & Jordan Lakes. Jordan Lake is located in Chatham County 30 miles west of downtown Raleigh, and includes seven access areas that provide plenty of camping, boating, and swimming opportunities. The beautiful lake is nearly 14,000 acres and is one of the largest summertime homes of the bald eagle. Make a day of it in one of our boat rentals, and you'll be sure to experience a few sightings of our national bird on Jordan Lake!
